reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.text: Pros: More leg room than expected. More than most other airlines I've flown. Wonderful service from the flight staff. Flew both ways, comfortable flights with soft take off and landing. Cons: Older and worn seating. Lack of inflight entertainment, central Screens mostly playing adverts. Inflight snacks were average to poor. Overall, for the price it was a good flight, leg room was welcome and super friendly flight crew was a plus, but bring some books or load up some films on your mobile device.
reviews.author: Majita1
